thinking: disabled by default using model metadata Jinja
limits: Single startup and bounded smoke; no real-35B reference-logit parity
API does not expose exact output token IDs
Process RSS is not a hard memory cap
Request wall time includes context construction, prefill and decode
monitor_incidents: RuntimeError('baseline PID identity changed; refusing to stop unrelated process')

memory.scope: VmHWM is the process lifetime kernel high-water mark; RSS and PSS are distinct final snapshots; arena covers only project staging

io.scope: Expert counters cover materialization; lifetime /proc I/O also covers hashing, loader reads and file-backed faults. Kernel read_bytes attribution is not a direct device bandwidth measurement.

timing_scope: One characterization with prior-run cache state uncontrolled. monitor_to_ready_seconds includes full verification and model load but omits the short launch-to-monitor gap; request wall time includes context creation, prefill and decode. No decode-throughput or speedup claim.
output_token_ids_unavailable_reason: HTTP server exposes text and usage counts, not exact output token IDs; this is not a numerical reference parity test.
monitor_incident_scope: The first monitor stopped at its own baseline PID guard before any request; Android cmdline lacked the assumed terminal NUL. The guard was corrected and monitoring resumed against the same already verified server. The failed monitor record is retained; the engine was not restarted.
